For an everyday work tote under ₹5,000, I’d shortlist:

Provider / option	Approx. price	Why shortlist
Everpret Work Tote	₹3,399	16" padded laptop sleeve, trolley sleeve, spacious, vegan leather. 
Everpret

Fastrack laptop totes	₹1,499–₹4,695	Strong value; multiple work-oriented designs and laptop compatibility. 
Fastrack

Miraggio	₹3,000–₹4,209	More polished/fashion-forward; structured office options. 
HotDeals360
+1

Before buying, check: final delivered price (including COD/shipping), laptop size, padded compartment, zip closure, water resistance, handle comfort and weight.

Returns/cancellation: verify the exact product's return window, whether returns are free, refund timeline, exchange-only restrictions, and whether sale/COD orders have different terms. Everpret currently advertises easy returns/exchanges; COD costs ₹100. 
Everpret
